links.comparator_used: Clinician reference ratings (expert review) of the same outputs
links.outcome: Agreement of LLM judges with clinician ratings on a seven-criterion rubric (safety, reliability, communication quality)
links.effect: Spearman ρ > 0.80 for safety screening and factual verification; ρ < 0.60 for communication quality; 19 LLM judges benchmarked
links.tradeoff: Patient advocates rated communication quality lower than both clinicians and LLM judges, so recalibration to patient-centered standards is needed.
links.quote: LLM judges achieved strong clinician agreement for safety screening and factual verification (Spearman  ρ > 0.80) but weaker agreement for communication quality (  ρ < 0.60).
